---
title: "Live demo"
output: rmarkdown::html_document
---

This is the demo app of `whence`, running in your browser. There is no
server: [shinylive](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/) runs R and
Shiny in the page with webR. The first start downloads R and the packages,
so it can take some seconds.

Things to try:

* Click a number. The panel shows where its rows went, and the code that
  makes it again.
* Press **View the rows** in the panel to see the rows that make the value.
* Change the region or the year, and click the number again. The code
  holds the new values.
* Open **Customers**. It uses `distinct()`, so the panel says that the rows
  cannot be found. The waterfall still works.

```{=html}
<div class="whence-live-demo">
  <iframe src="../demo/" title="whence live demo" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
<p class="small text-muted">
  <a href="../demo/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the demo in a new tab</a>
</p>
```

To run the same demo on your own machine:

```r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/demo", package = "whence"))
```
